rationale: Momentum cooled hard this run: 15m broke below EMA200 for the first time today, 1H MACD histogram deepened to -62.96, and 4H MACD histogram fell to -24.12, all while price drifted to a fresh session low (84,125) after a violent short squeeze near 84,700-84,925 reversed. The daily trend and the 82,874.5 support both remain intact, so this isn't a bias change, but heading into an unprotected overnight gap with cash already thin (46.64 USDT) ahead of the Oct-1 30 USDT charge, trimming a small slice of the spot core is the defensive move -- banking a bit of the DCA gain and rebuilding the cash buffer rather than adding into softening short/medium-term momentum or holding passively.

message.text: Trimmed 15% of spot core into session-low weakness to build cash ahead of the Oct-1 charge. Short/medium-term momentum is soft (15m below EMA200, 1H/4H MACD histograms both deeply negative) but the daily trend and 82,874.5 support are intact -- watch for a confirmed close below 84,125 overnight, that would open a retest of 83,818 then 82,874.5.

lesson.pattern: Two spot-core DCA adds already landed today (morning near the highs, midday on the first pullback) and by endday short/medium-term momentum had turned bearish-tilted with price at fresh session lows
lesson.insight: After two same-day adds, treat a third weak-momentum session as a cue to trim/build cash rather than add again or sit passively -- especially into an unprotected overnight gap with a known expense approaching.
